steps.headline: Which card look should every Settings menu use from now on?
steps.today: Each Settings screen currently uses its own mix of card boxes, borders, and amounts of see-through, so screens look like they were designed by different people.
steps.problem: Nothing ties the screens together — different corner styles, different amounts of glass, and different gaps between things make the app feel inconsistent from menu to menu.
steps.proposal: Every settings card, in every menu shown above, would use ONE look — either the dark card or the light card you just saw — with the same spacing everywhere.

options.label: Dark card
pros: Matches the look of the Backup & Sync card you already liked
Feels the least different from how Settings looks today
cons: In the darkest theme, this card's own color is exactly the same as the page behind it, so it depends entirely on its thin border to read as a card at all

options.label: Light card
pros: Its color is different from the page behind it in every theme, including the darkest one, so it always reads as a card by its color, not only its outline
Still solid, with no see-through glass anywhere
cons: A slightly bigger visual change from how Backup & Sync looks today, since its own card gets a touch lighter

options.label: Neither — keep looking
pros: No commitment yet if neither one feels right
cons: The inconsistency across Settings menus stays until something is chosen
